Monisha Chakraborty was serving as Chief General Manager -in- Charge in Department of Supervision. As a career central banker, Smt. items.title: Taxation laws (Amendment) Bill to attract more foreign capital, provide policy certainty introduced in LS
items.summary: A groundbreaking bill has been introduced to boost foreign investment while fostering local manufacturing in India. By simplifying regulations for fund managers and foreign cloud enterprises, the initiative aims to attract funding. Additionally, extended tax breaks for electronics manufacturing and component storage are part of the plan. The bill also introduces fees on specific electronic payment methods, positioning India as a more appealing destination for global investors.

items.title: Gen Z could unlock India’s Rs 315 lakh crore gold opportunity: Report
items.summary: India's gold market is poised for transformation driven by digitally savvy Gen Z consumers. This generation views gold as a flexible financial asset, fueling interest in digital products. Mobilizing household gold holdings could deepen financial markets and strengthen capital formation. The gold jewellery market is also at an inflection point, requiring innovation and omnichannel experiences. Creating a National Gold Board and Innovation Centre will drive this modernization.

items.title: E20 fuel protests: Why India's ethanol-blended petrol policy is under fire
items.summary: India's push for E20 petrol faces significant public and political opposition. Motorists express concerns about potential vehicle damage and reduced fuel efficiency. The government acknowledges minor efficiency dips but denies widespread engine failures. Auto manufacturers largely support the E20 blend, citing their own testing data. However, critics demand consumer choice and question the rapid nationwide rollout.

items.title: India's hospitality companies' revenue to grow 7-9% in FY27, West Asia conflict poses downside risks: ICRA
items.summary: India's hospitality sector anticipates seven to nine percent revenue growth this fiscal year. Premium hotel occupancy is expected to remain stable at seventy-two to seventy-four percent. Average room rates for premium hotels will likely increase to eight thousand six hundred rupees. Operating margins for these hotels are projected to be similar to last year's figures. However, geopolitical tensions pose potential downside risks to this outlook.

items.title: HSBC India profit rises 4% to $965 million in H1 2026, corporate and institutional banking drives growth
items.summary: HSBC India's profit before tax rose four percent in the first half of 2026. Higher revenue from corporate and institutional banking fueled this significant profit increase. The bank's wealth and premier banking division, however, saw profits drop sharply. HSBC India also led in mobilising foreign currency deposits under a special RBI scheme. Globally, HSBC reported a substantial twenty-three percent rise in pre-tax profit.

India mobile revenues grew 9.2% driven by improved ARPU and data customers. The company added a record one million net postpaid users during the quarter. This marks the nineteenth consecutive quarter of profits for Bharti Airtel.

items.title: Indian economy to hit USD 5-trillion mark in FY29 as per IMF: FM
items.summary: India's economic landscape is on a promising trajectory, aiming to exceed five trillion dollars by the fiscal year twenty twenty-nine. To attain this ambitious goal, the government is implementing a comprehensive growth strategy that emphasizes advancements in agriculture, manufacturing, and infrastructure. Key initiatives, including Production Linked Incentives and support for MSMEs, play an essential role in enhancing the country’s growth outlook both now and in the future.

items.title: PVR INOX bets on tier-III India with launch of SMART Cinemas
items.summary: PVR INOX is launching a new franchise model for tier-III cities. This capital-efficient format will expand organized entertainment options across India. The first SMART Cinemas property will open in Muzaffarpur, Bihar soon. PVR INOX has signed agreements for six more locations. This initiative aims to make premium cinema experiences more accessible.

items.title: Competing cues, caution ahead of RBI policy decision keep rupee nearly flat
items.summary: The rupee remained stable as traders awaited the Reserve Bank of India's policy announcement. Foreign bank dollar sales and importer hedging demand influenced currency movements throughout the day. Banking system liquidity improved, leading to lower forward premiums on dollar-rupee trades. Economists anticipate the central bank will maintain current policy rates but adopt a hawkish stance. Indian equities faced pressure, while bonds saw yields drift lower amid global market shifts.

items.title: Government tightens surveillance on GLP-1 weight-loss drug promotion amidst surrogate advertising concerns
items.summary: Central government directs state regulators to enhance surveillance over GLP-1 drug promotion. Approved GLP-1 drugs are only for Type 2 diabetes and specific weight management. Advisories were issued to manufacturers and drug controllers regarding product information. Regulators must monitor supply chains and take action against diversion. Advertising platforms will be monitored for non-compliant promotions and violations.

items.title: Nykaa Q1 Results: Net profit spikes 243% YoY to Rs 80 crore; revenue jumps 29%
items.summary: Nykaa's quarterly profit saw a significant increase, more than tripling year-on-year. Strong growth in the beauty business and fashion sales acceleration drove this profit rise. The company's revenue from operations also increased by over twenty-nine percent. Analysts expect continued strength across both beauty and fashion segments. Improved conversion and customer acquisition fueled the fashion business's sharp acceleration.

items.title: India paves way for return of merchant fees on digital payments
items.summary: India has laid the legal groundwork to reintroduce merchant fees on UPI payments through proposed amendments to the Payment and Settlement Systems Act. While no decision has been taken, the government is considering charging MDR only on large merchants or high-value transactions, potentially creating a ₹5,000-10,000 crore revenue pool for payment firms.

Ltd. honored six dedicated healthcare professionals for their contributions. Distinguished doctors and hospitals received awards for their exemplary work in Indian healthcare. The event highlighted advancements in diagnostics, treatment, and patient care.

items.summary: The regulator is considering wider exemptions and relaxed disclosure norms to encourage long-term foreign investment and reduce compliance burdens for offshore funds.

items.summary: Dabur said it has begun changing product labels after the FSSAI ordered it to stop selling food products carrying allegedly misleading “100%” claims, including honey, coconut water and apple cider vinegar. The company said the impact is limited to the affected products and that it is also seeking legal advice.

items.title: PM Surya Ghar scheme crosses 50 lakh rooftop solar installations
items.summary: The PM Surya Ghar scheme has now benefited over fifty lakh households nationwide. This significant milestone reflects rapid implementation of the world's largest rooftop solar program. Nearly nineteen lakh households are now receiving zero electricity bills after subsidy disbursement. Over twelve lakh households earned significant income by selling surplus power back. The scheme is reinforcing India's global leadership in clean energy adoption.

items.title: Lack of proper training in credit monitoring among reasons for frauds: CVC to banks
items.summary: The Central Vigilance Commission has advised banks on training to prevent frauds. Lack of proper credit appraisal and monitoring is identified as a key reason for these issues. Banks and financial institutions are urged to conduct training programs focusing on these aspects. This advice comes as part of a preventive vigilance campaign for public administration. The commission seeks action taken reports by November 30.

items.title: Government invites online applications from August 17-31 to get recognised as GATCs
items.summary: Industries can apply to become Government Approved Test Centres online until August 31, 2026. This initiative aims to expand India's verification ecosystem for weights and measures. Recognized centres will verify 23 categories of weighing and measuring instruments across various sectors. The expanded network will complement state departments and improve service delivery. This reflects the government's commitment to ease of doing business and consumer protection.

Volatility stemmed from weekly expiry and discrepancies under the newly introduced Closing Auction Session (CAS) framework, which triggered forced square-offs ahead of the RBI policy outcome.

Additionally, India has finalized several free trade deals with important international partners, enhancing market access and minimizing trade barriers for Indian enterprises.

items.title: Recent trend in net FDI inflows linked to increased investments by India, greater repatriation: Government
items.summary: Net foreign direct investment has declined significantly in recent years. This trend is linked to increased overseas investments by Indian companies. Greater repatriation by foreign investors also contributes to this shift. Indian enterprises are expanding globally for strategic assets and new markets. This reflects a maturing investment ecosystem and strengthening domestic capital.

items.title: Gaurs Group targets Rs 1,900 revenue from luxury residential project near Noida airport
items.summary: Gaurs Group is setting its sights high with a revenue target of Rs 1,900 crore for its latest luxury project, which will include 1,088 apartments spread over 11.8 acres near Jewar Airport. This ambitious development enhances their portfolio of premium residential options in a rapidly evolving area, which is thriving due to improving infrastructure as well as the ongoing airport developments.

items.title: What is the Nifty-Gold ratio signalling now? Could a new bull run in Indian equities be next?
items.summary: The Nifty 50-gold ratio has fallen to 1.70, indicating Indian equities may be undervalued compared to gold. Analysts suggest this could signal a shift towards increased equity exposure and a bullish market outlook if the ratio rises above 2.

Lynch emphasized his core investing rule to know what you own before putting money into any stock.

items.title: Currently nine trade disputes pending against India under WTO rules: Govt
items.summary: India is facing nine pending disputes at the WTO, Parliament was informed on Tuesday. The cases, filed by countries including Japan, China, the EU, Brazil and Australia, cover steel, sugar, ICT tariffs and PLI schemes. India has spent about Rs 2.43 crore on legal defence so far.

Consolidated net profit rose nearly 8% while revenue increased by ten percent. Sales volume dropped over 7%, impacted by fuel supply chain issues. The company's net debt decreased, and its net debt-to-EBITDA ratio improved.

items.title: 13 smallcap stocks see MF buying for 4 straight quarters; shares rally up to 103%

Senores Pharmaceuticals led the rally, while counters like Astra Microwave, Data Patterns, and Ujjivan SFB saw steady institutional buying.

items.title: Sebi aims to relax offshore fund investor-disclosure rules as appeals grow: Report
items.summary: India's market regulator is set to simplify disclosure requirements for offshore funds to entice more long-term foreign investment. The proposed adjustments include extending the disclosure timelines for fresh investors and increasing the thresholds for reporting specific investor information. These initiatives emerged in response to legal challenges and complaints from investors, seeking to create a more conducive environment for capital influx.

Russian crude supplies also show a recent decline, impacting global availability.

items.title: Your next car may 'talk' to nearby vehicles and save your life: Here's what's coming next
items.summary: India plans to mandate vehicle-to-vehicle communication technology for new vehicles. This system will allow cars to share vital data like speed and braking. Advanced Driver Assistance Systems will be complemented by this new communication capability. The technology aims to prevent accidents by providing early warnings to drivers. Implementation will occur in phases starting from October 2028.

items.title: What bubble? Amazon enters $3 trillion market cap club, CEO highlights striking AI demand
items.summary: Amazon shares reached a new high, briefly surpassing $3 trillion in market value. This surge followed a strong earnings report and increased investor confidence in artificial intelligence. The company's cloud services showed significant growth, exceeding expectations and boosting its valuation. Amazon anticipates substantial capital expenditures to meet future artificial intelligence demand. Other tech giants like Apple and Microsoft also saw their market values increase.

items.title: Restaurant Brands Asia shares surge nearly 20% on strong Q1 results. What Motilal, other brokerages said
items.summary: Restaurant Brands Asia shares surged nearly 20% after the Burger King India operator posted strong Q1FY27 results, led by robust same-store sales growth and a sharp jump in EBITDA. Brokerages, including Motilal Oswal and Nuvama, remained bullish, citing improving demand, margin expansion and growth supported by Inspira Global's investment.

items.title: Samsung India to offer festive discounts, interest-free EMIs as memory chip costs rise: JB Park
items.summary: Samsung will offer affordable purchase options and festive discounts to Indian customers. The company aims to absorb rising material costs as much as possible. Memory chip shortages and increased demand are impacting the electronics market. Samsung's Indian R&D centers are developing popular AI features for local users.

items.title: KEI Industries shares rose 9% to 4-week high on upbeat performance in Q1
